brief:
Gazans held a mass funeral to lay to rest 112 family members whose remains were recovered nearly three years after a November 2023 Israeli airstrike buried them in rubble, Mondoweiss reported. Among the dead was a mother found still embracing her three children. The recovery and burial came after families spent years searching for and locating their relatives.

The funeral took place as thousands of other dead remain missing or trapped beneath destroyed infrastructure across Gaza. Families described the experience of recovering their dead as reawakening grief that had begun to fade during the intervening years.
dek: Nearly three years after a November 2023 Israeli airstrike buried them in the rubble, Gaza families recovered 112 of their dead and laid them to rest, including a mother still embracing her three children.
title: Gaza families bury 112 recovered remains nearly three years after airstrike
